mechanism: LONG_CASCADE liquidation event where price is FAR from its rolling 24h low (dist_low_24h >= frozen threshold) -> LONG, fwd_4h horizon. 'Far from local low' beats 'at the low' (near-low flips negative OOS, far-low stable/improving).
source_evidence: reports/edge_discovery/alpha_hunt_2026-08-30/w2_liquidation_leverage/evidence/liquidation_L1_L5_deepdive_by_quarter_year.json#LONG_CASCADE_far24hlow_by_quarter/_by_year (by-year stability check, only 24h-lookback variant has this deepdive -- basis for picking dist_low_24h over dist_low_7d)

reports/edge_discovery/alpha_hunt_2026-08-30/w2_liquidation_leverage/evidence/liquidation_bucket_overlap_jaccard.json (independent n_b1=6713 for far_24h_low LONG_CASCADE, cross-checks L5's n=6709/6710)
threshold_selection_rationale: The source report describes the near/far-from-low split only in prose ('near'/'far' the 24h low), with no single published numeric cutoff -- it reports only resulting bucket sizes (far_24h_low n=6709-6713, near_24h_low n=7169, out of a LONG_CASCADE population of ~26.8k at report time). Reproduced here: recomputed the empirical distribution of dist_low_24h for kind==LONG_CASCADE via the UNCHANGED build_event_dataset() pipeline on the frozen 50-symbol universe, as of freeze time (2026-08-31, population n=27927, ~1 extra day vs report's ~26838 due to normal data drift). The 25th percentile of dist_low_24h is exactly 0.0 (many cascades occur literally at the 24h low), and the 75th percentile measured 0.0489 -- i.e. the report's 'far' bucket is the upper quartile, not a median split. Rounded to FAR_FROM_LOW_MIN_DIST_24H=0.05 (5%) as the frozen constant in far_from_low_variant.py. At this exact threshold, re-running the same cost/label convention (net = mean(fwd_4h)*10000 - 14bps, LONG_CASCADE only, label_full==True) on our data pull reproduces the report's far_24h_low bucket closely: full n=6804/net14=+6.7bps (report: n=6709/net14=+4.48bps), OOS(2025+) n=2409/net14=+19.84bps (report: n=2227/net14=+17.7bps). Chose dist_low_24h over dist_low_7d because the report's own deepdive evidence file only carries a by-quarter/by-year stability breakdown for the 24h-lookback variant (LONG_CASCADE_far24hlow_by_quarter/_by_year keys) -- the 7d variant (far_7d_low_full net14=5.74/OOS net14=15.48, evidence L5) is not weaker but was not independently vetted for temporal stability in the available evidence, so 24h was picked as the more conservatively-verified variant, not for higher expected return. SHORT_SQUEEZE variants (far_24h_low_full net14=19.61/OOS net14=73.34, far_7d_low similar) are NOT used despite materially higher reported net_bps -- SHORT_SQUEEZE is hard-blocked at the select_tradeable() level pending the unresolved sign-convention question (same reason as LIQ_CASCADE_REPEAT_V1, detector.py:95); only the LONG_CASCADE sub-range of the report's headline '+15.5 to +73.3bps OOS' range is achievable by this alpha, i.e. +15.48 to +17.7bps OOS depending on 24h/7d choice.

frozen_spec.far_from_low_threshold: dist_low_24h >= 0.05 (FAR_FROM_LOW_MIN_DIST_24H, frozen constant, ~75th percentile of dist_low_24h among LONG_CASCADE events measured at freeze time -- see threshold_selection_rationale)
frozen_spec.kind_filter: LONG_CASCADE only -- SHORT_SQUEEZE explicitly blocked pending sign-convention resolution (detector.py:95), enforced in select_tradeable()
